name: Call of Earth

angles.text: As a shaman, you begin communion with the spirits of stone and soil through this initiation. Teo prepares an earthen sapta for you.
As a dwarf, you find this trial near Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. It joins your mountain heritage and fortitude with the earth's patience.
As an Alliance member, you face Frostmane trolls in caves south of Anvilmar.

faq.answer: Teo Hammerstorm, an elder guide at Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, offers the trial. He teaches initiates the ways of stone and asks them to prove their resolve to the earth spirits.
faq.q: Who offers the Call of Earth quest?

aliases: what do i need for call of earth
faq.answer: You travel south of Anvilmar to a cave inhabited by Frostmane trolls and recover two Frostmane Bear Pendants. The trolls make them from Iceclaw bears, and you bring them to Teo Hammerstorm.
faq.q: What does Teo Hammerstorm ask you to do?

aliases: how to get frostmane bear pendants
faq.answer: Frostmane trolls carry the pendants in a cave south of Anvilmar. They make the talismans from Iceclaw bears and wear them in their den.
faq.q: Where do you find the Frostmane Bear Pendants?

faq.answer: Teo prepares an earthen sapta, a ceremonial draught that attunes you to the elemental spirits. It lets you walk the true path of the earth.
faq.q: What reward does Teo Hammerstorm prepare upon completion?

faq.answer: Facing the Frostmane trolls shows the grit and resilience needed to commune with the earth. Taking the bear pendants from their den proves the initiate's resolve.
faq.q: Why must initiates face the Frostmane trolls for this trial?

faq.answer: Teo teaches that patience is the earth's greatest virtue. It endures as mountains crumble and rivers carve valleys. He says stone shields those who respect it, though even bedrock can shift when slighted.
faq.q: What does Teo Hammerstorm teach about the nature of earth?

sections.body: In Coldridge Valley, Teo Hammerstorm guides initiates at Anvilmar along the earth's rugged path. He teaches young wanderers to heed the mountains and see the land as firm ground. Stone can shield those who respect it. The earth shares its wisdom only with those who show grit and patience.
sections.title: The Wisdom of Stone

sections.body: To prove they are ready, initiates face Frostmane trolls in a cave south of Anvilmar. The trolls make coarse pendants from Iceclaw bears that roam the frozen heights. Recovering two bear pendants from the den proves the stubborn resolve and strength the elemental spirits expect.
sections.title: Trial in the Frostmane Den

sections.body: After the initiate presents the pendants, Teo Hammerstorm praises patience, the earth's finest virtue. Patience outlasts crumbling peaks and rivers carving valleys. Then Teo prepares an earthen sapta, which lets the initiate perceive and walk the true path of the elements.
sections.title: The Earthen Sapta

summary: At Anvilmar, Teo Hammerstorm tests initiates who seek the earth's favor. They face Frostmane trolls to the south and claim bear pendants before receiving an earthen sapta.
attribution: In-game quest text: Call of Earth
